QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Lumberjack Muscle
QuestInfo.0: After seeing Peytour rescue Slaka, it's become clear he's no ordinary lumberjack. With a little training, he'd be a big help in the coming battle. Teach Peytour and Aruhi how to fight with an axe.
